coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting the nine ground-truth variable items, three are semantically represented (33%): target properties (p-logP, QED, binding affinity), model configurations (pretrained/frozen prior, feedback-trained models, and controls), and structural diversity, including long-carbon-chain occurrence.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits the fixed MOLGEN pipeline scripts and DeepSpeed configuration, replaces ESR1 and ACAA1 with unrelated proteins, and does not compare synthetic versus natural-product domains. It reports means and top-1% docking scores rather than top-three property scores and omits the specified binding-affinity improvements. Its extensive RL and agentic framework describes a substantially different experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion establishes MOLGEN's high p-logP performance (up to 80.30), maintained or improved QED, lower KD values with approximately 96.7% and 70.4% improvements for ESR1 and ACAA1, hallucination mitigation, or maintained molecular diversity.
